name: Leona
notes: Sunlight (P) is never dealt in this fight: its bonus damage is consumed by an allied champion's hit, and there are no allies in a 1v1 dummy fight, so it is left unmodeled.

Shield of Daybreak (Q) is read as an instant, no-cast-time attack-empowerment (per the wiki's 'cast time: none'), not the 0.25s the bin's castTime field lists; it shares this attack-modifier pattern with abilities like Emberstrike and Thundering Smash that do not lock Leona out.
Q's cooldown starts when the empowered attack actually lands (cdstart = post-effect), not on cast; Leona recasts Q the instant it is both off cooldown and unarmed.

The empowered attack's extra reset ('does not put the basic attack on cooldown... effectively a second attack reset') is modeled as: the attack immediately following a consumed Q needs only its windup, not a full attack period, before the next attack.

Eclipse (W) is cast on cooldown the instant it is available (cast time none, cooldown starts on cast); its flat damage reduction and bonus armor/MR are ignored since the stationary dummy never attacks, so only its guaranteed detonation 3s later is modeled.

Zenith Blade (E) is cast on cooldown; its damage lands on the cast with the usual 0.25s cast lockout. The sword's flight time, the forced dash, and the automatic post-dash basic attack are not modeled (no exact travel-time number is given), matching how the reference driver treats a short, unmodeled dash.

Solar Flare (R) is cast at t = 0 and again on cooldown thereafter; its damage lands 0.625 s after the cast (the stated impact delay), and its cooldown is read as starting on cast since no post-effect timing is stated for it.
Mana is not modeled: none of Leona's costs are large enough relative to her cooldowns to bind inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
